94d8fde8769cc7eb2e8032f3e2840b6551bb794e.sourceText: *如果A>B，Err为正，就往水缸里面加水；如果A<B，Err为负，就从水缸里面舀水出来。那么只要预期水平面和实际水平面有差值，我们都会通过水桶去加减水来调整系统。同时Kp的大小也有对系统的性能有影响。如果Kp的值比较大，优点是从B平面达到A平面的速度快，缺点是在B平面已经接近A平面的时候系统会产生比较大的震荡。如果Kp的值比较小，优点是B平面在接近A平面的时候系统震荡小，缺点是从B平面达到A平面的速度慢。*
94d8fde8769cc7eb2e8032f3e2840b6551bb794e.translatedText: *If A\>B, Err is positive, and water is added to the tank; if A\<B, Err is negative, and water is scooped out of the tank\. Therefore, as long as there is a difference between the expected water level and the actual water level, we will adjust the system by adding or removing water through the bucket\. At the same time, the value of Kp also affects the system's performance\. If the value of Kp is relatively large, the advantage is that the speed from plane B to plane A is fast, but the disadvantage is that when plane B is already close to plane A, the system will produce relatively large oscillations\. If the value of Kp is relatively small, the advantage is that the system oscillates little when plane B is close to plane A, but the disadvantage is that the speed from plane B to plane A is slow\.*
